definitions.explanation: Travel by ship across water, especially long-distance ocean travel.

examples.english: To set out on a voyage.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{一周|いっしゅう}{航海|こうかい}
{大航海|だいこうかい}{時代|じだい}には、{多|おお}くの{探検家|たんけんか}が{未知|みち}の{大陸|たいりく}を{目指|めざ}して{航海|こうかい}した。
examples.english: During the Age of Exploration, many explorers sailed in search of unknown continents.

notes:
{航海|こうかい} refers to sea voyages.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {航海|こうかい}{士|し} (navigator, mate)
- {航海|こうかい}{日誌|にっし} (ship's log)
- {大航海|だいこうかい}{時代|じだい} (Age of Exploration)
- {遠洋|えんよう}{航海|こうかい} (ocean voyage)

NOTE: Different from {後悔|こうかい} (regret) and {公開|こうかい} (public release).
